binary.help:
Convert static JPEG, PNG, AVIF, and self-contained SVG images with libvips

Usage: image-optimizer [OPTIONS] <INPUT>

Arguments:
  <INPUT>  Source file or directory. Symlinks are not followed

Options:
      --out-dir <OUT_DIR>        Destination tree. Original filenames and relative directories are retained
  -o, --output <OUTPUT>          Exact destination for one source and one variant. Format is selected by --format
      --recursive                Include subdirectories, excluding the destination tree
      --width <WIDTH>            Fit within this width without cropping
      --widths <WIDTHS>          Comma-separated srcset widths, at most 32 unique values
      --height <HEIGHT>          Fit within this height, optionally combined with width
      --format <FORMAT>          Output encoding. Preserve reencodes rasters or resizes the SVG viewport [default: webp] [possible values: webp, preserve]
      --quality <QUALITY>        Lossy JPEG, AVIF, or WebP quality. PNG remains lossless [default: 80]
      --effort <EFFORT>          WebP/AVIF encoder effort or PNG compression, from 0 to 6 [default: 6]
      --cpu <CPU>                Libvips worker threads, not a hard process CPU cap [default: 1]
      --upscale                  Allow enlarging small inputs to the requested bounds
      --overwrite                Atomically replace existing regular outputs. Never replace input files
      --dry-run                  Plan outputs and inspect headers without writing or fully decoding pixels
      --json                     Print one schema-versioned JSON report to stdout
      --max-pixels <MAX_PIXELS>  Reject source or output images above this pixel count. Not a hard memory limit [default: 100000000]
  -h, --help                     Print help
  -V, --version                  Print version
